facts.text: Evan attributes his motivation to his family and a smart watch that tracks his health progress.

evidence.quote: My family motivates me to stay healthy. Well, it helps a lot with my health goals. It tracks my progress really well and serves as a constant reminder to keep going.
It's been awesome, Sam! That visual reminder has been really motivating.

facts.text: Evan has been working on his health journey for two years and acknowledges there have been ups and downs.

evidence.quote: I've been working on it for two years now, so there have been ups and downs, but I'm doing my best.

facts.text: Evan is motivated by a desire for adventure, particularly through interesting hikes.

evidence.quote: I'm motivated by a thirst for adventure on interesting hikes, that's pretty cool!
